acceptanceCriteria: A claim with several --scope paths (both one flag per path and several paths after one flag, if supported) reserves every requested path, or refuses naming the unaccepted ones; a regression test covers a re-claim after release.
Claim output lists the effective reserved scope, so an operator can see a dropped path before submit.
body:
Suspected defect, not yet minimised. corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.456, 2026-10-12, primary checkout on main.

Observed twice during post-merge closeouts. (1) V1-1301: `claim V1-1301 --base <merge^1> --scope p1 p2 ... p18` returned OK and re-activated the earlier released attempt id 5131052d (generation 369), but submit of the merge tree refused OUT_OF_SCOPE naming .corvint/changes/*.cem.json, .corvint/unbounded-readers.json and cmd/corvint/testdata/* that were in the --scope list. (2) V1-1308: `claim ... --scope a --scope b ...` (one flag per exact path, 35 paths) returned OK with attempt d48cc184 (generation 372), whose reservation resources were only the ticket recorded touchPaths (12 keys, no cmd/corvint/testdata/ entries); submit refused OUT_OF_SCOPE on the cmd/corvint/testdata goldens. In both cases `widen` with the same exact paths then succeeded and submit/gate/complete passed.

Expected: claim either reserves the union of the ticket touchPaths and every requested --scope path, or refuses/warns naming the dropped paths. Actual: OK with no warning, and the requested paths are absent from .git/taskman/reservations.json. Usage text says `[--scope PATH...]`, so it is also unclear whether one flag may carry several paths.

(3) 2026-10-12, CORE-GITHUB-MERGE-QUEUE-COMPATIBILITY-1 (touchPaths coverage QUALIFIED, previous attempt expired): `claim ... --base 15456ec4 --scope docs/build-log/2026-10-12-merge-queue-first-merges.md --scope .corvint/changes/070fcd632953579f905b36c16816a1d1368350a1.cem.json` returned OK, attempt 1a777802 generation 373; reservations.json held only the 8 recorded touchPaths. submit --tree 46e38694 refused OUT_OF_SCOPE naming exactly those two paths; widen with the same two paths, then submit, gate run focused-docs and complete --commit 4e609405 all succeeded. Third reproduction with the one-flag-per-path form, so the pattern is consistent: a ticket with recorded QUALIFIED touchPaths ignores --scope on claim.

title: Suspected: claim returns OK but drops requested --scope paths when re-activating a ticket, so submit fails OUT_OF_SCOPE
